subject: Separate execution brain memory and local git state boundaries
description: Implement the architecture decision from the user conversation: create a clean seam so execution owns live process/session/worktree/lease state and brain/memory owns planning/context/durable notes. Make git-synced claim data durable/audit-oriented, not the source of truth for live liveness. Support many workspaces per machine and single-repo or multi-repo workspaces by avoiding absolute local paths/process ids in git-synced claim records. Keep the change narrow and aligned with existing patterns. Add focused tests.
